_comment: Personal API key: Linear Settings -> Security & access -> Personal API keys. Nothing needs selecting; exclude_teams is for dropping a noisy automated intake. Keep this file chmod 600.
_token_comment: Linear personal API key; leave empty to read the named environment variable.
_token_env_comment: Environment variable that holds the Linear API key.
_exclude_teams_comment: Linear team identifiers omitted from every aggregate.
_window_days_comment: Days included in issue and cycle trend charts.
